summary: Enanta Pharmaceuticals filed a prospectus supplement on Form 424B5 for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $75 million in common stock. The company entered into a sales agreement with Jefferies as sales agent; shares will be sold at prevailing market prices, with a 3.0% commission. This is a routine shelf takedown under Rule 415(a)(4), not a special situation. The filing provides ongoing capital access, with no fixed price, premium, or structural complexity typical of special-situations events.
